reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is param + '_SafeStuff' (user input) written to HTML response. User-provided data flows through queryString → param → bar, with no encoding/mitigation applied before response.getWriter().print(bar). The X-XSS-Protection header is set to '0' (disabling protection), but this does not neutralize the vulnerability. Case TP: at least one alert-TP.

evidence.note: User input sourced from getQueryString() and processed into param
User-derived param is appended with '_SafeStuff' and directly written to response without encoding
